# Pokémon from Unova (optional)

Professor Rowan's last start-of-game question ([options](options.md)). With Yes, Pokémon from Unova (Generation 5) live in the wild all over Sinnoh, the Gym Leaders, the Elite Four and the Champion battle with Unova Pokémon in their teams, and Veilstone Dept. Store sells the stones the Unova families evolve with. With No, the game is the original's. A game saved before the question existed starts with them off; the aide on the west side of Professor Rowan's lab switches them on and off. The Pokémon you caught stay with you either way.

- Every Sinnoh Pokémon is still in every place it was; where one gets rarer, it gives up part of a large share. The new Pokémon take about a quarter of each kind of encounter where the place has room (the sea's surfing much less: Tentacool and Wingull keep their share). The Old Rod never changes.
- Version pairs, as Black and White: Lustrous Pearl has White's side, Adamant Diamond Black's: Petilil / Cottonee, Solosis / Gothita, Vullaby / Rufflet, Throh / Sawk, and Basculin's Blue-Striped / Red-Striped Form. After the Hall of Fame each version also gets the other's, in one more slot of the same places.
- Starters, 1 % each, in both versions: Snivy on Route 204 North, Tepig on Route 206, Oshawott on Route 205 South.
- The Pokédex: the Sinnoh Pokédex stays as it is; the Unova Pokémon are in the National Pokédex. Their AREA page shows their places only with the option on (the other version's side after the Hall of Fame), and the HABITAT list lists them with it on.
- A Unova Pokémon has no walking sprite: with one first in your party, the next one walks behind you.
- Veilstone Dept. Store 2F, the vitamins counter, with the option on: also the Sun, Moon, Shiny, Dusk, Fire, Water, Thunder and Leaf Stones.
- Karrablast and Shelmet (Eterna Forest) evolve when the other is in your party; Boldore and Gurdurr at level 35 (no trade needed).

The share of each kind of encounter. "After the Hall of Fame" marks the other version's side.

## Teams

With the option on, the first battle with each Gym Leader, the Elite Four and the Champion; the new Pokémon keep the level and held item of the one they replace (rematches are the original's). The Champion has her team from Black and White (Undella Town: Spiritomb, Eelektross, Milotic, Braviary, Lucario, Garchomp) with its moves, abilities and genders, at her levels here, Garchomp highest, no held items.
